meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: Claude 会先为界面选定一个大方向——排版、配色、动效、布局，再写出能直接运行的前端代码（HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue 等）。它会避开 Inter、Arial 这类常见字体和紫色渐变等通用 AI 风格。
howto.when: 当你要构建网页、应用组件或界面，并明确表示不想要千篇一律的 AI 味设计时，它会接管。

say.text: 帮我做一个作品集页面，走编辑杂志风，要有滚动动效
say.note: 会先定美术方向再给可运行代码

say.text: 重构这个 React 登录组件，换掉默认字体和紫色渐变
say.note: 替换掉通用 AI 风格

say.text: 把这个页面改成极简排版，留大量留白

howto.what_en: Claude first commits to a bold aesthetic direction — type, color, motion, layout — then writes working frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, etc.), avoiding generic AI looks such as Inter/Arial fonts or purple gradients.
howto.when_en: Use it when building a web page, component, or app interface and you want to avoid generic AI-looking design.

say_en.text: Build a portfolio page in editorial magazine style with scroll motion
say_en.note: Picks an aesthetic direction, then writes runnable code

say_en.text: Refactor this React login component; drop the default font and purple gradient
Redo this page as ultra-minimal typography with lots of whitespace
say_en.note: Leans into a restrained minimal direction
